messages.subject: Welcome to the network
messages.body:
Terminal access confirmed, choombas.

This relay is your uplink for the job. Check the DATABANK for the target dossier and keep COMMS open. I will ping you when the window opens.

Stay frosty.
- W

messages.subject: They are listening
messages.body:
Someone burned a backdoor into the militech-relay host.

The passphrase is hidden on the 91.3 band. Morse. Old school.

Delete this after reading.
